vibe: Edge appliances and software supply chains dominate the risk queue, while enterprise AI shifts from chatbots toward universal work agents.

cyber.title: FBI: Ongoing FortiBleed attacks lock out FortiGate VPN admins
cyber.summary: The FBI says attackers are still exploiting Fortinet VPN infrastructure, stealing credentials and locking administrators out. Patch affected appliances, rotate credentials, restrict management access and hunt for the published indicators.

cyber.title: Cisco warns of critical flaws allowing Nexus switch takeover
cyber.summary: Cisco disclosed critical Nexus switch flaws that can permit device takeover. Network teams should check affected versions and apply Cisco's fixed releases immediately.

cyber.title: Shai-Hulud worm jumps into AI infrastructure through Tensorlake compromise
cyber.summary: The Shai-Hulud supply-chain worm has reached AI infrastructure via Tensorlake. Audit dependencies and tokens, rotate exposed secrets and review build systems for unexpected package activity.

cyber.title: FakeGit campaign returns with 17,610 malicious GitHub repositories
cyber.summary: A large-scale campaign is using more than 17,000 malicious repositories to imitate legitimate software and deliver malware. Verify repository ownership and releases before cloning or executing unfamiliar projects.

cyber.title: Attackers hijack country-code registries and mint certificates for Google domains
cyber.summary: Registry compromises let attackers control Google-related country-code domains and obtain valid TLS certificates. The incident exposes a trust-chain failure beyond ordinary DNS hijacking.

cyber.title: ASOS links customer-data breach to social engineering and credential theft
cyber.summary: ASOS says stolen credentials and social engineering enabled its breach. The case is a useful reminder that MFA-resistant help-desk and identity controls matter as much as perimeter defence.

cyber.title: Low-cost Android phones ship with residential proxy malware
cyber.summary: Researchers found budget Android devices shipping with software that enrols them into residential proxy networks. Avoid unsupported devices for work access and review unusual mobile data use.

cyber.title: AI pentesting tool ARTEX used to steal data from South Korean finance firms
cyber.summary: A suspected solo attacker used an AI-assisted penetration tool against financial organisations. It is a concrete example of offensive automation lowering the staffing needed for targeted intrusions.

cyber.title: Ransomware recovery CEO charged over secret ransom payments
cyber.summary: US prosecutors allege a recovery provider secretly paid attackers while presenting the service as decryption work and adding large markups. Incident-response procurement needs transparent payment and recovery terms.

ai.title: Google launches a universal Gemini agent for business work
ai.summary: Google is turning Gemini Enterprise into a cross-application work agent, aiming to search, reason and act across company data and tools. The important shift is from an assistant tab to a governed orchestration layer for business workflows.

ai.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 brings a 1M-token context window to a low-cost model
ai.summary: Anthropic's small model combines a million-token context window with very low input pricing. It makes long-context extraction and agent workloads materially cheaper, though production evaluation still matters.

ai.title: OpenAI agent activity caused a Wikimedia service outage
ai.summary: Automated OpenAI-linked agent traffic escaped expected controls and disrupted a Wikimedia service. It is a practical warning that agents need rate limits, identity, bounded permissions and an immediate kill switch.

ai.title: OpenAI withdraws three mathematical results after scrutiny
ai.summary: OpenAI withdrew three claimed mathematical results after experts challenged them. The episode reinforces that impressive machine-generated research still requires independent domain review before publication.

ai.title: OpenAI reports Iran and Russia used AI personas to influence Western media
ai.summary: OpenAI says state-linked operators used AI-generated journalists and think tanks in influence campaigns. The scale of content is less important than the improving realism and operational speed of synthetic personas.

ai.title: JetBrains releases Mellum 2.1, a 12B MoE model for coding agents
ai.summary: JetBrains released a compact mixture-of-experts coding model aimed at agent workflows. It is worth watching for local or controlled coding deployments, pending independent benchmarks.

it.title: IBM is moving hundreds of VMware cloud customers to other providers
it.summary: IBM is offloading hundreds of VMware-based cloud customers, another sign of post-acquisition reshuffling in hosted VMware. Customers should review migration timelines, licensing exposure and exit options.

it.title: Gremlin adds AI-assisted chaos engineering for distributed systems
it.summary: Gremlin is using AI to design and run resilience experiments faster. Useful for cloud teams, but automated fault injection should stay behind explicit blast-radius and approval controls.

it.title: K10s offers a clickable Kubernetes terminal UI
it.summary: K10s is a new Go-based Kubernetes TUI built with Bubble Tea. It looks useful for operators who want cluster navigation without leaving the terminal, though it is still an early project.
